leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom module that exports functions and variables
Apply the require() function to import built-in Node.js modules
Construct a module that exports a default function using module.exports
Configure a module to export multiple named values using an object
Integrate multiple custom modules into a single main application file
Manipulate imported module data within your application logic
Initialize a project structure that separates code into logical modules
